text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――Oguri Cap, who has continued to achieve results in GⅠ races.
As a reward, we went out to eat, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...*gulp*.
Excuse me, could I get another hamburger?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...?
I can eat as much as I want, right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I'd better not after all.
Just as I thought..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to take a break for salad first.
Could I get 10 corn salads?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...This is my reward for fighting through a GⅠ race.
Let's just forget about my wallet for now..."

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey, isn't that girl Ogurin?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Oh gosh, you're right!
Ogreene!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Ogurin?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Wah, he turned around!
So cool~♪

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
We're cheering for you, Ogurin!
Good luck in your next race too!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah... Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even in the Central, Oguri Cap now boasts
top-class popularity.
That, too, is a result of her journey of self-improvement.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
Being cheered on really does make me happy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"For the next race, too,
I want to run in a way that makes everyone cheer for me."
choice_data_list: Next is the Tenno Sho (Autumn), right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Tama's waiting for me too,
so I need to keep getting stronger and stronger.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Somehow, a fire is starting to burn in my belly.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
After the salad, order me
50 big hamburgers!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sparkling shine in Oguri Cap's eyes
is so dazzling right now...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...What!?
Is this place... not an all-you-can-eat buffet!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: F-Forgive me, Trainer. I had assumed this was something akin to a cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer?
Tr-Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, Oguri Cap finished
her second warrior's pilgrimage.
